subject.title: Discord plugin does not auto-reconnect after 1006 WS close (forces full gateway restart, kills in-flight turns)

question: Is the new live 1006 evidence sufficient to sponsor a narrow reconnect-lifecycle repair now, or should maintainers first require a public-path root cause for the stale reconnect state?
rationale: A previous direct candidate PR was closed unmerged after maintainer review found the proposed stale-state setup was not production-reachable, but this issue now has fresh v2026.6.11 live evidence of the same failure mode.

options.title: Sponsor Narrow Lifecycle Repair
options.body: Use this issue plus the closed candidate PR context to identify or instrument the real transition and fix self-reconnect without adding a new operator-only workaround.

options.title: Accept Chokepoint Mitigation
options.body: A maintainer can reopen or replace the close-handler mitigation if the live production evidence is enough despite the still-unidentified owner transition.

options.title: Require More Runtime Trace
options.body: Keep collecting timestamped 1006 close-to-failure traces before authorizing repair work if maintainers need current-main or deeper transport proof.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Narrow Lifecycle Repair
recommendation.body: Use this issue plus the closed candidate PR context to identify or instrument the real transition and fix self-reconnect without adding a new operator-only workaround.

likelyOwner.reason: Most recent and central history across Discord gateway supervision, ws transport, heartbeat, and reconnect/delivery hardening points to this owner for the proof-sufficiency decision.
